text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you've been feeling unwell for the past few weeks. Can you tell me how old you are and if you have noticed any specific spots or rashes on your skin along with the bruising?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. I need to check for signs of bleeding or infection; have you noticed any small red or purple spots (petechiae) on her skin, or has she had any bleeding from her gums or nose? Also, is there any swelling or tenderness in her legs or abdomen that might suggest bone or organ involvement?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.
